'''International relations'''
*[[Colombia–United States relations]], [[Mass deportation of immigrants in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Colombia]]n  [[President of Colombia|President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] blocks two [[U.S. military]] aircraft carrying deported [[Colombians]] as part of [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s immigration crackdown from landing in his country. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/jan/26/colombia-gustavo-petro-trump-deportation-flights (''The Guardian'')]
**In response to President Gustavo Petro's refusal, U.S. President Donald Trump enacts a 25% [[tariff]] on all goods traded to the U.S. from Colombia, which will be raised to 50% in one week. Hours after Trump's announcement, President Petro orders the [[Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism (Colombia)|commerce ministry]] to raise tariffs on U.S. imports by 25%. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/26/politics/colombia-tariffs-trump-deportation-flights/index.html (CNN)] 
**The dispute is settled with an agreement to use the [[Colombian Air Force One|Colombian presidential plane]] to fly the deportees from the U.S. to Colombia. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-immigration-deportation-flights-petro-trump-us-67870e41556c5d8791d22ec6767049fd (AP)] [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5107740-colombia-presidential-plane-honduras-us-deportation-flights/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[Belarus–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] announces the release of [[American citizen]] Anastasia Nufer from a prison in [[Belarus]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/us-citizen-belarus-prison-release-rubio/33289470.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions]]
**[[United Nations]] [[Secretary-General of the United Nations|Secretary-General]] [[Antonio Guterres]] urges [[Rwanda]] to end its support for rebels in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and withdraw [[Rwanda Defence Force|Rwandan soldiers]] from Congolese territory. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/26/un-chief-calls-for-rwandan-forces-to-leave-drc-as-rebels-press-offensive (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|Congolese Foreign Minister]] [[Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner]] calls Rwanda's military support for [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels a "[[declaration of war]]". [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-updates-un-chief-urges-rwanda-to-pull-back-troops/live-71416951 (DW)]
